title: schizocodon ilicifolius var. intercedens
intro: Schizocodon ilicifolius var. intercedens, commonly known as East Asian schizocodon, is a plant species belonging to the family Diapensiaceae. The plant is traditionally used in East Asian medicine to treat various health conditions. Its health benefits include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator. The bioactive constituents of East Asian schizocodon include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
